subject: math
title: Intro to Fractions: Unit Fractions and Comparing
key_points: When a whole is split into n equal parts, each part is 1/n
The numerator tells how many parts you have; the denominator tells how many equal parts make a whole
When denominators are the same, the fraction with the larger numerator is greater
You can use a picture (circle or bar) to check that the parts are equal

vocabulary.definition: The number on top of a fraction; how many parts you have
The number on the bottom of a fraction; how many equal parts make a whole
A fraction with 1 as the numerator, such as 1/2 or 1/4

worked_examples.problem: A pizza is cut into 8 equal slices. Mia eats 3 slices. What fraction of the pizza did she eat?
solution_steps: The whole is split into 8 equal parts, so the denominator is 8
She ate 3 parts, so the numerator is 3
The denominators are the same: both are 5
4 is greater than 2, so 4/5 is greater

practice_seeds: What fraction of the figure is shaded?
Name the numerator and denominator of 5/8
